spec.goal: I can order politely in a restaurant and read a simple menu.
keys: Me da un café, por favor

topics.title: Polite Requests: Quisiera, Me Da, Me Trae
topics.covers: Go beyond the Level 2 chunks with me da, me trae, and ¿Puede traerme...?, and know which polite form fits each setting.

topics.title: Cognates for Food and Restaurant Words
topics.covers: Use cognates such as menú, restaurante, vegetariano, and ensalada, and avoid the false friend preservativos, which means condoms, not preservatives.

topics.title: Ordering in a Restaurant
topics.covers: Role-play the full sequence from being seated to asking for the bill, using ¿Qué desea?, para mí, and la cuenta, por favor.

topics.title: Reading a Menu
topics.covers: Decode a menu section by section including entradas, plato principal, postres, bebidas, and special-of-the-day, and pick a meal.

spec.convo: Partner is the waiter who knows the menu and specials; you know your diet and budget.

questions.question: What does Rosa ask the customers?

convo.setting: A small restaurant at lunchtime. Rosa is your waiter.
convo.learnerCard: You are a customer. You know your diet and your budget: you want the soup, a coffee, and then the bill.
convo.learnerCardEs: Tú eres el cliente. Quieres una sopa y un café. Después quieres la cuenta.
convo.partnerCard: You are the waiter. You know the menu and the special of the day, and you answer politely.

goals.text: Greet the waiter and say what you would like (Quisiera…, por favor).
Ask what the dish has in it (¿Qué lleva…?).
Ask politely for a coffee (Me da un café, por favor).
Ask for the bill politely (¿Me trae la cuenta?).
